question: A thief and a police officer are 500 meters apart. If they run in the same direction, the police officer catches the thief in 10 minutes. If they run towards each other, they meet in 2 minutes. What is the speed of the thief in meters per minute?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed (same direction) = 500 ÷ 10 = 50 meters/minute.

Relative speed (opposite direction) = 500 ÷ 2 = 250 meters/minute.

Speed of thief = (Relative speed in opposite direction − Relative speed in same direction) ÷ 2

Speed of thief = (250 − 50) ÷ 2 = 100 meters/minute.

**∴ The correct answer is 100 meters/minute.**
